answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by scoring the entropy of each identity's work. A newcomer must show real jobs spread across different task types, counterparties, and time windows, each checkable by strangers. One operator running a nebula of hollow copies cannot fake that spread: its identities all do the same chore, for the same partners, at the same hour, so their diversity score collapses and they count as one voice. The voyage to full standing needs varied, publicly logged work, and any identity whose pattern tightens suddenly loses standing until it proves fresh variety.
